description: Workout: one outdoor cycling session from a watch, with totals, its zone, a route attachment link and a device link (health v2.10)
notes: health:activityType carries the source's identifier under a source namespace (healthkit:), never a mapped code. The route and device are referenced by IRI only: they live in other files of a pod, which is why health:WorkoutShape checks sh:nodeKind sh:IRI and not sh:class. The source id is written raw, as a string, and its id space goes in health:sourceIdSpace. Fully synthetic.
